families.label: Impersonation
families.definition: A message or interaction falsely presents itself as a trusted person, organisation, service, or authority.

families.label: Advance-fee
families.definition: A target is asked to pay or provide value upfront to receive a promised benefit that is fictitious or misrepresented.

families.label: Investment opportunity
families.definition: A deceptive investment, trading, or return-generating proposition.

families.label: Employment or recruitment
families.definition: A deceptive job, recruitment, task, or employment-related proposition.

families.label: Romance or relationship
families.definition: A relationship-based deception used to obtain money, credentials, or other value.

families.label: Account takeover
families.definition: A pattern intended to obtain access to or control of a victim's account.

families.label: Payment redirection
families.definition: A target is induced to send money to an unintended recipient or destination.

families.label: Mobile-money abuse
families.definition: A deceptive pattern targeting mobile-money services or transactions.

families.label: Delivery or parcel
families.definition: A deceptive delivery, customs, parcel, or shipment-related proposition.

families.label: Charity or disaster appeal
families.definition: A deceptive donation or assistance appeal.

families.label: Technical support
families.definition: A deceptive support or device-security interaction intended to obtain access or value.

families.label: Other or emerging
families.definition: A pattern not adequately represented by an existing family; requires a documented rationale.
